summary: Create a new campaign. Google requires channel type + budget + start; Meta reuses advertising_channel_type as objective; TikTok/Snap/etc. use it as objective_type. Irreversible (creates a live ad object).
group: PAID ADS (Google / Meta / TikTok / Snap / LinkedIn / Pinterest / X / Reddit / Apple)

params.name: platform
params.doc: All 9 ad platforms now implement create_campaign.

params.name: account_id
params.doc: Ad account / customer id (validated up front).

params.name: campaign_name
params.doc: Campaign name. Required for all platforms.

params.name: advertising_channel_type
params.doc: Google: channel type (SEARCH|DISPLAY|SHOPPING|VIDEO|PERFORMANCE_MAX). Meta: objective (OUTCOME_SALES|OUTCOME_TRAFFIC|...). TikTok: objective_type (TRAFFIC|CONVERSIONS|REACH|VIDEO_VIEWS). LinkedIn: objectiveType (BRAND_AWARENESS|WEBSITE_VISITS|LEAD_GENERATION). Pinterest: objective_type (AWARENESS|TRAFFIC|VIDEO_VIEWS). Snap: objective (APP_INSTALL|AWARENESS). X: objective (APP_INSTALLS|WEBSITE_CLICKS|ENGAGEMENT|VIDEO_VIEWS). Reddit/Apple: not used (omit or pass default).

params.name: daily_budget_usd
params.doc: Required for Google (→ micros). TikTok/Reddit use as-is or convert. Snap/X/Reddit convert to micro-USD. Meta/Apple/Pinterest/LinkedIn optional.

params.name: start_date
params.doc: YYYY-MM-DD. Required for Google; optional for Snap/X.

params.name: end_date
params.doc: Google: optional end date.

params.name: bidding_strategy_type
params.doc: Google: defaults to MAXIMIZE_CLICKS when omitted.

params.name: status
params.doc: Meta/Snap/Reddit: defaults to PAUSED. LinkedIn/Pinterest: defaults to ACTIVE. Google/Apple: uses ENABLED/PAUSED. Apple uses ENABLED (not ACTIVE).

scope: Google: inline SCOPE_GA4_FULL (Full Access) check; Meta: token presence only

params.name: payload
params.doc: payload.lead_ids (array of strings) REQUIRED.

params.doc: payload.lead_ids (array of strings) REQUIRED.

returns: Raw Marketo REST envelope { result:[{id, status}] } | error

params.doc: Marketo campaign id.

params.name: payload
params.doc: payload.lead_ids (array) REQUIRED; payload.tokens (array of objects) optional.

params.name: payload

params.doc: payload.leads (array of objects) is REQUIRED. payload.lookup_field (default 'email'), payload.action (default 'createOrUpdate').

returns: Raw Marketo REST envelope { result:[{id, status}] } | error

summary: Change a campaign's daily budget. Mutates live ad spend. Google converts USD→micros; Snap/X/Reddit→micros; TikTok/LinkedIn/Pinterest passes USD as-is; Meta converts to cents; Apple uses {amount, currency}.
group: PAID ADS (Google / Meta / TikTok / Snap / LinkedIn / Pinterest / X / Reddit / Apple)

params.name: platform
params.doc: All 9 ad platforms now implement update_campaign_budget.

params.name: account_id
params.doc: Ad account id. Validated up front for all non-marketo platforms (returns bad_request before action check).

params.name: campaign_id
params.doc: Campaign to modify.

params.name: daily_budget_usd
params.doc: New daily budget in USD. Google/Snap multiply by 1_000_000 (micros); TikTok uses raw USD.

scope: Google: inline SCOPE_GA4_FULL (Full Access) check; other platforms: none beyond token presence

summary: Enable/pause a campaign. Mutates live delivery. status is uppercased before the connector call (google/meta/tiktok/snap); linkedin/pinterest/x/reddit/apple pass status as-is.

params.name: platform
params.doc: Supported on all 9 ad platforms.

params.name: account_id
params.doc: Ad account id (validated up front).

params.name: campaign_id
params.doc: Campaign to toggle.

params.name: status
params.doc: Target state. google/meta/tiktok/snap call .upper() on it; other platforms pass it through verbatim (case-sensitivity inconsistency).

scope: Google: inline SCOPE_GA4_FULL (Full Access) check; others: token presence only
